title: Fixed-open core for gluing smallness of perfect classes
statement: For a fixed open immersion f : Y ⟶ X with opensRange f = U ⊔ V, under the three smallness hypotheses on U, V and U ⊓ V and derived-category structures on Y and all its opens, the skeleton of perfect derived quasi-coherent objects on Y is u-small.

proof.text: Transport the three smallness hypotheses to the inverse-image opens of Y, use the derived Mayer--Vietoris triangle, and encode perfect cocones by a u-small type of triples and maps computed via K-injective resolutions. Uniqueness of cocones up to isomorphism gives a surjection onto the perfect skeleton; apply small_of_surjective.
